name: dinotty-vscode
description: Connect VS Code terminals to Dinotty sessions.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package

enumDescriptions: Use the native VS Code terminal theme without injecting color OSC sequences.
Apply only Dinotty foreground, background, and cursor colors.
Apply Dinotty foreground, background, cursor, and ANSI palette colors.
dinotty.terminalAppearanceMode.description: Controls per-terminal Dinotty color synchronization. Changes apply to newly created terminals.

dinotty.syncAppearanceFromDinotty.deprecationMessage: Use dinotty.terminalAppearanceMode instead. An explicitly configured true value maps to exact; false maps to native.
dinotty.syncAppearanceFromDinotty.description: Deprecated compatibility setting for Dinotty terminal colors.
